summary: Phase-4 testing of Image Hosting, Backfill, and Smart Dedupe. 31/31 backend pytest tests pass (added 7 new). Playwright validated the Fetch Scheduler Maintenance section: backfill-btn and dedupe-btn both return 200 with toast; hosted /api/images/* URLs render correctly on admin cards (20/20) and public feed (2/3 - rest is fallback). Published rows are preserved by dedupe.
critical_code_review_comments: backfill_news fires asyncio.create_task(enrich_items(ids)) without bounds; invoking the button repeatedly or from multiple admins can stack 100+ concurrent enrichments. Consider a module-level lock / in-flight flag.
dedupe_news uses Jaccard>=0.6 on title tokens; purely-Devanagari titles with <3 tokens are skipped (len(s) < 3 check uses word count, not characters) — ok but worth a comment.
serve_image sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 but there is no ETag/Last-Modified; CDN re-validation will be weak.
GET /api/images/{path:path} does not restrict path; path traversal is naturally bounded by object storage SDK but add a regex/whitelist on allowed prefixes (e.g., must start with 'samvad/news/').
host_image failures are silently swallowed (returns None) — add metric/log counter so backfill success rate is observable.
AdminDashboard.jsx still 584 lines; SchedulerModal (with Maintenance), AddNewsModal, NewsCard should live in separate files.
Still open from prior iterations: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials; no rate limiting on auth; no index on news_items.source_url.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 7 tests: backfill/dedupe auth, backfill queued, dedupe preserves published, hosted image public fetch, 404 for missing image, approve-rewrite hosts image internally)
seed_data_creation: None. test_backfill_returns_queued triggers background enrichment (idempotent). test_dedupe may remove near-duplicates but preserves Published.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backfill/dedupe buttons live inside scheduler modal (data-testid=backfill-btn, dedupe-btn). Scheduler modal does NOT auto-close after backfill/dedupe (only on save-scheduler-btn). imgSrc() prepends REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to '/api/images/...' paths. Hosted image example path pattern: /api/images/samvad/news/<uuid>.{webp|jpg|png}. Public image endpoint has no auth. Approve-rewrite does on-demand enrichment incl. host_image on og:image.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 3 new features verified end-to-end. Hosted images load with correct natural dimensions (1600x900/1200x675) proving image/* content-type and binary integrity.
